title: Community Partner Project
text:
Overview
[Placeholder — full project description to be written.]
The semester-long applied project is completed in partnership with the Northern Border Regional Commission (NBRC), a federal-state economic and community development commission serving rural northern Maine, New Hampshire, New York, and Vermont.
Students work in small teams. Each team analyzes a different domain area across the full NBRC four-state territory (rather than each team covering a different state). All teams use a consistent structure so outputs are comparable and can be assembled into a unified product for NBRC.

A core component is a semester-long applied project delivered to an external community partner: the Northern Border Regional Commission (NBRC).

title: Applied Data Science & Visualization
text:
Community Partner
Our applied project partner is the Northern Border Regional Commission (NBRC), a federal-state economic and community development commission serving rural northern Maine, New Hampshire, New York, and Vermont. Student teams will produce data-driven analyses across domain areas (housing, broadband, workforce, etc.) covering the full NBRC four-state territory.
See the Project page for team assignments and deliverables.

Full course policies, grading, and expectations are on the Syllabus page.
